newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian child sex 'horror house' to be demolished.
newsitem.headline: Belgian child sex 'horror house' to be demolished.

text.p: The house where two eight-year-old Belgian girls died at the hands of a paedophile gang is to be torn down and a momument put up on the site, officials said on Tuesday.
The demolition of the house in the town of Sars-la-Buissiere, near Charleroi, south of Brussels, is to take place in the next few weeks, municipal officials said.
They said the monument would be dedicated not just to Julie Lejeune and Melissa Russo, whose bodies were found in the garden of the house, but to the memory of missing and abused children in general.

The house was owned by convicted child rapist Marc Dutroux who led police to the spot last August, sparking a scandal which has caused a massive public outcry in Belgium over bungling by justice authorities and shaken the government.
In another Dutroux house the bodies of An Marchal, 17, and Eefje Lambrecks, 19, were later found.
